_notes: Teachable concepts, each taught ONCE at the moment it first matters and
replayable forever from the Casebook (owner rule 2026-08-04). Delivery
pages    -- notice-style cards; for ideas ('what gleam is for')
practice -- opens the real screen with its own coaching, on throwaway
content, and comes back here; for anything with rules you
learn with your paws. `scene` is a component-runner spec.
A quest teaches by carrying a {type:lesson, lesson:<id>} step. Profile
key `taught` remembers which have played, so a lesson never repeats
itself uninvited and the Casebook can grey out the ones not met yet.

the_exchange.name: Gleam, and What It Buys
the_exchange.blurb: Buttons, teeth, and the Magpie who takes them.

pages.title: Gleam
lines: Gleam is what the city pays for trouble taken off its hands. Buttons, mostly. Teeth sometimes. Once, memorably, a very small key.

It rides in your SATCHEL while you are out and only becomes yours when you come home. Die on the way and the satchel stays where you dropped it — the Court takes a quarter of what is already banked, and takes it politely.

pages.title: The Magpie Exchange
lines: Brindle sells ENERGY CARDS. A card bought is a card in the spool the next time you go out.
Cutting costs nothing and happens at home: every card you own keeps, and you wind the spool you want from On the Prowl. A thin deck that is all teeth beats a fat one full of apologies.

growing_stronger.name: Getting Harder to Kill
growing_stronger.blurb: There is no experience bar. There is work, and what it leaves you.

pages.title: No Ledger of Yourself
lines: Nothing in this city keeps a running total of how good you are getting. You will not find a number for it, because there is not one.
You get stronger the way anything does: you do difficult work, and afterwards some of it has stuck to you.

pages.title: What Sticks
lines: Work leaves three kinds of mark. More LIVES IN HIM — a wider heart, and more room to be wrong in. More SPOOL — cards in the deck, so a long night does not end in an empty hand.
And new ACTIONS, which is the only one that changes how a fight feels. Five go out with you at a time, Scratch included; choosing which is a real decision and it is made at the Mantel.

the_case_board.name: Keeping the Thread
the_case_board.blurb: Suspects, things, and what connects them.

pages.title: The Board
lines: Every lead ends with a THING — a stub, a page, a tally. The thing goes on the board, and the board remembers so you do not have to.
Suspects appear when evidence names them. A thread between a thing and a name is not an accusation. It is a question you have stopped being able to un-ask.

asking_questions.name: Getting a Straight Answer
asking_questions.blurb: Testimony: pull the ribbon that cannot hold.

pages.title: Testimony
lines: Nobody in this city lies outright. They tell you a shape of a story, and one strand of it is doing more work than it can carry.
Put a piece of EVIDENCE against a strand. If the two cannot both be true, the strand goes. What is left standing is what actually happened.

favor_knots.name: Favor-Knots
favor_knots.blurb: Debts worn where everyone can see them.

pages.title: Favor-Knots
lines: A favor owed to you is a KNOT tied in your thread, where anyone who reads the Weft can see it. Nobody welches on a visible debt.
A knot is spent, not saved: untying one opens a door that gleam cannot. The Case Board keeps count of who owes you.

stitching.name: Seam & Stitch
stitching.blurb: Her craft. Numbers, thread, and a seam that closes.

pages.title: Seam & Stitch
lines: Each clue counts the threads that must touch it. Sew until every number is answered and no more.
SQUINT when you are stuck: it says whether anything already sewn is wrong. It does not say which.

warding.name: Patching a Ward
warding.blurb: Holding a hole shut with the wrong colour thread.

pages.title: Wards
lines: A ward is a promise stitched into a doorway, and promises tear. Patch each gap with energy of the humour it is crying for.
MOONLIGHT patches anything, which is why there is never enough of it.

crossings.name: The Long Way Round
crossings.blurb: Same deck. No claws. Get to the other side.

pages.title: Crossings
lines: Some rooms cannot be fought through. Same hand, same spool — different question: what does it cost to get across?
Spend to move, spend to stay unseen, and do not arrive with nothing left.

unpicking.name: The Unpicking
unpicking.blurb: Taking a lattice apart without waking it.

pages.title: The Unpicking
lines: Somebody's work, holding something shut. Pull the threads in an order that never leaves the whole thing hanging on one.
Cut wrong and it does not break — it TIGHTENS. That is how you know it was made by a professional.
